cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll choose us a decent bunch this time. Taste that grape first; we won't buy sour ones again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One will tell us enough. You try it and I'll take the next if the assistant is happy with that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you hold the bunch where she can see it. No hiding behind me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll present it properly; you can make the first selection. Give me a nod if she lets you finish, and I'll join you.
